annotations.title: Read or search the fuast docs

description: Read one docs page as markdown (page), or search every page for words (search). With neither, lists the pages. Useful pages: capsule-api (every server and client API), database, auth, limits, storage, schedules, email, teams, examples/todo.

page.description: Page name from the list, for example "capsule-api" or "examples/todo".

search.description: Words to find. Returns matching lines with their page and line number.
